messages:
Ryan: Quick life update  two tiny wins: 1) today marks my 3-year anniversary at Redwood, and 2) I finally found the ring in time to propose this weekend :ring::tada: Low-key terrified and very happy. Thinking a tiny potluck next Wed 5pm in the lounge?
Zoe: RYAN WHAT?! congrats x 1000!! :confetti_ball: potluck yes please. I can bring a cheap but delicious sheet cake.
Hana: omg congrats on both!! so excited for you. Wed 5pm works for me. Ill bring a veggie tray.
Omar: Huge congrats!! :raised_hands: I vote empanadas. Also can we have a tiny card for the anniversary and engagement?
Leila: love this. I can do napkins and a playlist. Also vote: :cake: cake, :taco: empanadas, :cookie: cookies.
Ryan: Vote poll time  Im honestly fine with anything but cake might be nice. Thanks everyone  youre making me blush.
party-bot: Reminder created: "Ryan double-win potluck" at 1720066800 (Wed 17:00)  react to RSVP by EOD Tuesday.
Zoe: Ill start a Google doc for contributions. Also if you want us to help keep the Saturday proposal low-key surprise, DM me.
Ryan: Thank you all  means a lot. No gifts, just vibes and carbs. :heart:
